findings.reason: a control that names the same dominant read by a 99.5% margin on any half cannot fail, so it verifies nothing; the same log already carries a discriminating arm — the fast-render population (render < 0.1 s, n=717) distributes read time across `_cached_run_time_profile` 45.5%, `list_live` 38.8% and `template_load` 13.0% — so requiring the analysis to name a different structure there would prove it can distinguish a slow-render cause rather than always returning the same answer.
